question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Seasonable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"seasonable"** means something that is appropriate or suitable to the season or circumstances; timely. (समय पर)

 
 
• **Example: **We enjoyed a **seasonable** amount of rainfall this year, which was perfect for the crops.
 
 
 
• **"Inappropriate" **refers to something that is not suitable or proper in the circumstances. (अनुचित)
 
 
• **Example: **Wearing a swimsuit to a formal event is considered **inappropriate.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'seasonable' **is **'inappropriate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Timeous **(समय पर): Occurring at a favorable or useful time; timely.

 
 
• **Example:** The timeous intervention by the fire brigade prevented the fire from spreading further.
 
 
 
• **Towardly **(उपयुक्त ): Archaic term meaning promising or favorable.
 
 
• **Example: **The young apprentice showed a towardly attitude towards learning the trade.
 
 
 
• **Kind** (दयालु): Having or showing a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.
 
 
• **Example:** She is always kind to everyone, offering help whenever needed.
